roles.description: The current owner listing one specific NFT for sale: parks nft_id, unyt_index, price, and their own payout key, then triggers settlement once a matching escrow lock appears. Replace the placeholder key with the real seller agent key. A fresh agreement instance should be created per listing -- see README.

The party locking exactly the listed price as an escrow spend. Replace the placeholder key with the real buyer agent key, or use { "Any": null } to let any agent buy at the listed price -- see README for the trade-off.
